briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Anthropic Claude 4.5 escalate frontier race amid compute constraints

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies as frontier labs release iterative models while regulatory scrutiny grows. Multi-agent systems dominate deployment discussions amid persistent security gaps.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with enhanced reasoning; Anthropic releases Claude 4.5; Google DeepMind unveils Gemini 3 preview. Meta open-sources Llama 4 weights under new license.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits delays; Microsoft announces $40B Texas supercluster; TSMC secures new AI chip orders from xAI and Amazon.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory harmonization slow US-China AI divergence before 2028?
